get.summary: Page through the audit records, newest first
get.description: Reads one page of the audit table across every tenant and the rows that belong to none, newest first. All supplied conditions apply together: the time window plus each non-empty set of actions, outcomes and actors. Paging is cut by row identifier rather than by offset, so rows appended while paging do not shift the page that follows. The page size defaults to 50 and is capped at 200; the answer's next is empty on the last page.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Read rows at or after this instant, RFC 3339

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Read rows before this instant, RFC 3339

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Narrow to rows carrying one of these actions

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Narrow to rows whose outcome is one of these

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Narrow to rows whose actor is one of these

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continue after the row this cursor names

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page's maximum size; the read surface caps it

200.description: One page of records and the cursor of the next, empty on the last page

400.description: A query parameter the route does not accept, a time bound that is not RFC 3339, an empty action, outcome or actor, a limit that is not a non-negative integer, or a cursor the read surface did not hand out

403.description: The caller holds no audit.read in the platform domain

get.summary: Read one audit record by its row identifier
get.description: Reads one audit row by its identifier. The identifier is unique over the whole table, so the row is found whatever tenant it belongs to, or when it belongs to none. The identifier must be a non-negative decimal integer and the request must carry no query parameter; anything else is a 400. An identifier of zero, or one that no row holds, is a 404.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The row identifier, a non-negative decimal integer

400.description: The path parameter is not a row identifier, or a query parameter is present that the route does not accept

403.description: The caller holds no audit.read in the platform domain

404.description: The table holds no record with the identifier

AuditAdminRecord.description: One audit row as the query routes render it: the recorded fact, the identity and capture path behind it, and what it acted on.

id.description: The row identifier, rendered as text

tenant.description: Empty when the row belongs to no tenant

occurred_at.description: When the recorded fact happened, in UTC

actor.description: The acting identity's responsibility key, that is the identity that really acted; empty when the row records a system operation. An impersonated account is named in detail.on_behalf_of instead

source.description: The capture path that produced the row

action.description: What was done, as the emitting call site and the reader agree to spell it; the audit module fixes no vocabulary

object.description: The type of the thing acted on, together with its identifier

detail.description: Empty object when the row carries no detail

AuditAdminRecordPage.description: One page of audit records and the cursor that continues after them.

entries.description: The records on this page, newest first

next.description: The cursor of the next page, empty on the last page

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. This is the entry point's default error shape, which a host-supplied ErrorResponder may replace.

type.description: The machine-readable code identifying the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the RFC 9457 default about:blank; codes this platform defines are URNs of the form urn:speed:<capability>:<code>.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the standard English status text for the status code.

status.description: The HTTP status code the response is written with, repeated from the status line.

detail.description: A longer explanation of this occurrence, present only when the answering module has one to give. It may be a sentence rendered in the request language or a language-neutral token such as "forbidden", so clients must not parse it.

instance.description: A URI identifying this occurrence; absent when there is none to give.
